title: Hello Neighbor - Raven Brooks
description:
Hello Neighbor to Minecraft.

Requires at least two players. A single player can play through the map, but isn't as fun without a second player.

Hope you enjoy! Though, not everything I wanted is implemented yet, it is a Demo only.
body:
# Welcome to Raven Books

Nestled in the Missouri plains is a small little town known for its oddities. Take the role as a Raven Brooks Banner Journalist and play against another player.
